question.html:
Coil P and coil Q are rectangular coils. The areas of the coils are parallel. There is an anticlockwise direct current in coil P as shown on the diagram. Coil Q is first moved towards coil P, then away from coil P.

What is the direction of the induced current between points A and B when coil Q is moving towards and away from coil P?

Induced current between A and B when coil Q is moving towards coil P

Induced current between A and B when coil Q is moving away from coil P
A. Towards the left Towards the right
B. Towards the left Towards the left
C. Towards the right Towards the right
D. Towards the right Towards the left
